explanation: It was dedicated in 1986 as a Bahá'í House of Worship, open to people of every faith. Its 27 marble-clad petals stand in clusters of three to form nine sides.

claims.text: The Lotus Temple in Delhi is a Bahá'í House of Worship.
The Lotus Temple is not a Hindu, Buddhist or Jain temple.
The Lotus Temple was dedicated in 1986.
Bahá'í Houses of Worship, including the Lotus Temple, are open to people of all religions.
The Lotus Temple has 27 marble-clad petals arranged in clusters of three to form nine sides.
